prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1077; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the accident happened?
A: I was driving through an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, turning left onto the main road.
Q: What was the traffic signal showing when you began your turn?
A: It was a green light for me, but I had to wait for oncoming traffic to clear before going.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. I saw headlights when I started to move, and then there was a bang on the driver's side of my car.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did you have your airbags deploy?
A: The front airbag came out, yes.
Q: Did you get out of the vehicle or speak with the other driver at the scene?
A: I got out for a minute. The other driver said they were sorry and that they thought they had time to get through.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same day. They diagnosed whiplash and told me to rest my neck.
Q: How are you feeling now?
A: My neck is stiff, and I get headaches when I turn my head quickly. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week.
Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?
A: I've been out for a few shifts, and I'm still working on getting back to full duties.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was careful and I didn't do anything to cause this. I'd like the claim handled as quickly as possible.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
